text:
kai: FYI publish is blocked by regendiff-check; it inferred a minor bump because CHANGELOG headers were reordered after regen.

leah: Can you paste the regendiff snippet?

kai: Tiny diff: ```diff
-### Fixes
-
-- doc: clarify auth retry behavior
+### Enhancements
+
+note: mention auto-retry for SDKs
```
Only docs changed but our semver heuristic treats "Enhancements" as a minor.

sam: Also seeing a failing sample-app auth integration after the same regen: retry count went from 1 -> 2. Test expects single retry. Pinning previous typegen artifact locally makes it pass.

kai: Ran `typegen --inspect` on old vs new. Diff shows `retry_policy.max_retries: 1 -> 2` for the Dart/Go generator. Commit id: abc123def. This is a behavior default change, not just docs.

release-bot: regendiff-check failed at 1749013000. Logs: https://ci.internal/regen/9999.

leah: Immediate unblock plan: (1) pin typegen artifact in publish job to unblock release, (2) patch regendiff-check quickly to ignore CHANGELOG.md and docs/releases/* when computing semver, (3) open an INF ticket to coordinate with codegen owners about the retry default bump and decide revert or language-gated opt-in.

sam: I'll also harden the sample app test to assert on explicit client config (config.Retry.Max) so CI doesn't flake on generator defaults while we decide.

kai: Pinned artifact and reran publish job — CI is green and release proceeded. Created INF-8733 with regendiff output and typegen diff. Leaving follow-ups for next devex sync.
